category_summary:
**Bot Screen & Live Desktop Launch (dominant story):** The week belonged to the **[Bot Screen](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa)** debut in **Hermes Desktop**. **@NousResearch**'s official launch post introduced [real-time streaming of any bot session](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa) so users can watch agents drive a browser or terminal live, while co-founder **@Teknium**'s companion announcement of [visual + interactive passthrough](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) to the same machine a **Hermes Agent** is controlling was the community's biggest post at ~1,046 likes. **@tonbistudio** produced the [walkthrough video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d), with the official account sharing docs at a strong 488 likes and [Teknium amplifying it further](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9). Sentiment was strongly positive and clearly anticipatory — Teknium's ['Finallllly!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6) (69 likes / 4.3k views) and ['Much needed!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) (189 likes / 18.6k views) suggest this was one of the most requested Hermes capabilities, with ['Impressive!'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-015fe011793b) reactions to community demos rounding out the excitement.

**oh-my-hermes Plugin & JEV Tooling:** **@rlaope** had a productive week: [open-sourcing **jeval**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-99948938337f) for JEV model evaluation and visualization plus an **oh-my-hermes** update adding [**JEV skills** and **model routing**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) (models/aliases, skills/plugins, workflow decisions), and positioning [**OMH** as the 'all-in-one plugin for AI-native'](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f) **Hermes Agent** users. A [condensed re-share of jeval](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-8530d32deea5) was demoted as a near-duplicate of the fuller release post.

**Maintainer Responsiveness & Attribution:** Founders stayed hands-on in the replies. **@Teknium** [pushed back on a claimed cache bug](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec) and asked for a reproducible issue path — confident but showing minor friction — [confirmed a fast fix](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b) after user feedback, and [corrected misattribution](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21) by clarifying a circulating tool was built by **NousResearch**, not Anthropic. Overall read: responsive, opinionated maintainership.

**Usage Tips:** A practical official tip that users can [run **Hermes via iMessage**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517) with any model they choose drew solid engagement, and [community reaction to the new guide video](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b1cd1c2e155e) was warm if casual.

**Filtered as noise:** Emoji-only and one-word hype replies (🔥, 😭, 'I agree', 'This is the way'), a bare OMH link re-post, a generic 'drop your GitHub' engagement prompt, and vague off-topic chatter about **Claude Opus 5.5** (GA 2026-09-22) and Claude Code were excluded from the ranked list for lack of informational value.
